blocks.raw: <Tip>**Memory aid:** UAP + RA 9266 = architects (older profession, broader scope). PIEP + RA 10587 = environmental planners (newer profession, planning-specific mandate). Both can contribute to planning; EnPs have the statutory CLUP mandate.</Tip>
